summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 CombinedSitePlan enhancements on lead d0df5baa. All 3 features work end-to-end. (1) Snap threshold dropdown [data-testid=site-plan-snap-select] renders in edit mode with 4 options (off/subtle/normal/strong), defaults to 'normal', and value persists to localStorage 'sitePlanSnap' across a full page reload (verified 'strong' and 'off' both survived reload). (2) PDF export downloads site-plan.pdf (164KB, no console error); pypdf inspection confirms 5 pages: Page 1 cover sheet contains 'Roof Measurement Site Plan', company name 'RoofSpan Roofing Co.', 'Prepared for: TEST Cat Lead', 'Property: 9d2ff9 Cat St, Austin, TX 78701', Date, 'Prepared by: Owner'; Page 2 combined plan with property address header; Pages 3-5 per-structure (House, Attached Garage, Front Covered Porch) each show the property address as header. (3) Regression testids all present: site-plan-north, site-plan-scalebar, site-plan-address, site-plan-export-png, site-plan-export-pdf, combined-site-plan-reset; combined plan still renders 3 structures with dim tags.
critical_code_review_comments: CombinedSitePlan.jsx is 350 lines and handles a lot (rendering, drag+snap, PNG/PDF export, cover sheet build, per-structure sketch rasterization). Consider extracting exportPdf/structurePng into a separate module for maintainability.
exportPdf silently skips logo on addImage failure — a console.warn would help debugging cover-sheet issues in prod.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 enhancements (snap threshold tuning, address everywhere, PDF cover sheet) verified working on lead d0df5baa. PDF text was inspectable via pypdf — cover sheet + address on every page confirmed. Snap select is visible without an explicit edit toggle click on this build (editable defaults on). Synthetic drag/snap-guide DOM verification not attempted (harness precision noted in iter_81); dropdown persistence + 'Off' wiring verified as fallback per request.
